title: Observation
description: One fact read from a source: a subject, an aspect of it, and a value. Observations are what harvesters write and what analysis reads. They say what is there, never what it means. Store many as JSON Lines (one observation per line). Capture phase.

id.description: Prefix OBS-. Unique within the capture run.

source.description: The source this fact was read from.

subject.description: The thing the fact is about. 'kind' comes from the adapter's subject vocabulary (e.g. family, type, parameter, nested-family).

key.description: Stable key for the subject within the source, e.g. 'Door-Single-Flush.rfa' or 'Door-Single-Flush.rfa/param/TXT_Company'.

parent.description: The key of the containing subject, if any.

aspect.description: What about the subject, from the adapter's aspect vocabulary, dotted: 'name', 'category', 'parameter.group', 'parameter.isShared', 'nesting.isShared'.

value.description: The value as read. Any JSON type. null means 'read, and empty'; a fact that could not be read is not an observation — record it as a problem on the capture run.

method.description: deterministic = a script/API read; re-running gives the same value. manual = a person recorded it. ai-assisted = an AI read it (e.g. from a video or a scanned PDF); such facts must be spot-checked before analysis relies on them.

context.description: Anything that helps locate or interpret the fact without interpreting it: file version, host version, type name, view.
